diagnosis: The exact-Selmer-rank subproblem is not blocked by a lack of downstream arithmetic structure in the good-ordinary Kurihara representation. Kim-Pollack prove that the discrete Kurihara order equals Bloch-Kato Selmer corank. The remaining rank-two entry edge is a coordinate-calibration problem: exact complex Taylor order must equal the discrete Kurihara order. Kim-Pollack state that equality as Conjecture 1.6, while proving only parity in Corollary 1.5 and exact equality in the low-analytic-rank <=1 special case of Corollary 1.10.
what_changed_from_prior_failures: R11 prevented counting the complex/discrete mismatch itself as new. R14 adds a stronger direct same-Q downstream theorem cell and an exact source label for the missing calibration (Conjecture 1.6), so routing now targets the conjectural calibration rather than further Selmer-structure machinery.
